description: This file contains the implementation of the 'git notes' command as a builtin in the Git source code. It includes functions for listing, adding, copying, editing, showing, merging, removing, pruning, and getting references for notes associated with Git objects. The code manages notes operations, handles user options and conflicts, and integrates with other Git subsystems like refs and objects.

methods.name: void free_note_data(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a note_data structure, including temporary files, buffers, and messages.

methods.name: int list_each_note(const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,char * note_path UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Prints the object ID and note ID for each note, used as a callback during listing.

methods.name: void copy_obj_to_fd(int fd,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads an object from the object database and writes it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void write_commented_object(int fd,const struct object_id * object)
methods.description: Uses 'git show' to produce a comment-formatted output of an object.

methods.name: void prepare_note_data(const struct object_id * object,struct note_data * d,const struct object_id * old_note)
methods.description: Prepares note data for editing or creation, including launching an editor if necessary.

methods.name: void write_note_data(struct note_data * d,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Writes note data into the object database as a blob.

methods.name: void append_separator(struct strbuf * message)
methods.description: Appends the separator string to a message buffer, handling newlines appropriately.

methods.name: void concat_messages(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple note messages into a single buffer, adding separators and handling whitespace.

methods.name: int parse_msg_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a message argument from command line options, storing it in note_msg structure.

methods.name: int parse_file_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a file argument for note content, reading from a file or stdin.

methods.name: int parse_reuse_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reads note content from an existing object to reuse as a note.

methods.name: int parse_reedit_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Marks the note data to be edited, reusing existing content.

methods.name: int parse_separator_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets the separator string used between note paragraphs.

methods.name: int notes_copy_from_stdin(int force,const char * rewrite_cmd)
methods.description: Copies notes between objects, reading input lines from stdin.

methods.name: struct:notes_tree * init_notes_check(const char * subcommand,int flags)
methods.description: Initializes notes for a subcommand, confirming the ref is within 'refs/notes/'.

methods.name: int list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists notes, either for a specific object or all notes.

methods.name: int add(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Adds or overwrites a note for a given object, handling conflict resolution.

methods.name: int copy(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another, with options for rewriting and stdin input.

methods.name: int append_edit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles appending or editing notes for an object.

methods.name: int show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays the note for a given object.

methods.name: int merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts a notes merge and cleans up temporary references.

methods.name: int merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by committing the merge result.

methods.name: int git_config_get_notes_strategy(const char * key,enum notes_merge_strategy * strategy)
methods.description: Reads the merge strategy from git config.

methods.name: int merge(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs a merge of notes, managing conflicts and finalizing or aborting the merge.

methods.name: int remove_one_note(struct notes_tree * t,const char * name,unsigned flag)
methods.description: Removes a note for a specific object, handling errors if not found.

methods.name: int remove_cmd(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Removes notes for specified objects or from stdin, then commits if successful.

methods.name: int prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prunes notes according to specified options, optionally reporting pruned notes.

methods.name: int get_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs the current notes reference.

methods.name: int cmd_notes(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git notes' command, dispatching subcommands based on user input.
